# Investigate reported 'looping' in Hermes' recent sessions, fix the root cause, and add rules to stop it recurring.

%% generated by scripts/obsidian-sync.ts: edit the sources, not this file %%

**Tasks:** [[tasks/PSI-108|PSI-108]] · **Agent:** claude-code · **Operator:** ardian · **Outcome:** done

**Session:** 2026-09-27 13:55 WIB → 2026-09-27 14:18 WIB · branch `task/PSI-108-repo-hygiene`

**Human review:** not required

## Summary

Traced two problems in Hermes' PSI-081/PSI-082 sessions: (1) it ran `git checkout <branch>` directly in the one shared main working directory, sometimes while docs/list-task-project.md/obsidian-out were uncommitted, then re-ran obsidian-sync on the new branch, producing near-duplicate handoff/'update workspace.json' commits and two nearly identical blocked write-ups on PSI-082 seventeen minutes apart; (2) PSI-081 was built, merged and frozen `blocked` (missing .env.local Supabase keys), then a later session re-implemented it from scratch against the same unmet precondition instead of escalating, landing at `outcome: partial` on the identical blocker. Separately found `obsidian-out/.obsidian/plugins/` and five per-user Obsidian app-state files tracked in git despite an existing (non-retroactive) .gitignore rule; none of it is written by scripts/obsidian-sync.ts, and the `remotely-save` plugin's own data.json explicitly warns it holds an encrypted remote-storage credential blob, a live secret-leak risk. Fixed: git rm --cached the app-state files and plugins/, extended .gitignore, added three coordination rules to docs/agent-operations/README.md (never switch branches in a dirty shared folder — use a second worktree; escalate rather than retry an already-hit blocker; never commit Obsidian's own app state). Also found and merged master into task/PSI-066 so its own history stopped reintroducing the untracked paths, without touching Hermes' in-progress uncommitted work. This entry itself is a retroactive record: the PR #46 session ended without one, which this fixes (C-14).

## Changes

| Path | Action | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `.gitignore` | modified | Ignore obsidian-out/.obsidian/{app,appearance,graph,types,workspace}.json and plugins/ |
| `obsidian-out/.obsidian/plugins/` | deleted | git rm --cached; vendored plugin bundles, never generated by our tooling |
| `obsidian-out/.obsidian/workspace.json` | deleted | git rm --cached; per-user UI state |
| `docs/agent-operations/README.md` | modified | 3 new coordination rules against the branch-switch/retry loop and committing Obsidian app state |
| `task/PSI-066 (merge commit 5251947)` | modified | Merged origin/master in so PR #45's own history stops reintroducing the untracked paths; Hermes' uncommitted work restored untouched |

## Decisions

- **Fix by removing tracking + gitignore + rules, not by rewriting any branch's history**: task/PSI-066 was an active branch with another agent's uncommitted work in the shared folder; rewriting history there is forbidden (never rebase/force-push someone else's branch) (alternatives: git filter-repo to scrub history entirely (unnecessary: the sensitive file was never actually committed))
